outlook.other: No tax-rate, sales, capex, FCF, amortization ($), interest, pension or SBC guidance was stated in the Q2-26 release (the last explicit annual tax-rate guidance was 22.5% before discrete items for FY2024, in the Q1-24 release). Non-GAAP outlook excludes certain transaction and integration costs and acquired intangible asset amortization (per-share bridge: FY T&I $0.02/$0.01, FY amortization $3.70/$3.65; Q3 T&I nil, Q3 amortization $0.95/$0.90). Raised from Q1-26 outlook (GAAP $20.08-20.44, non-GAAP $23.85-24.15). Qualitative: record orders/sales/OI in Q2-26, ~$5.0bn funded backlog at quarter end, $450m debt repaid at start of Q2, "continue to review a number of acquisitions"; risk list adds the 2026 US-Iran conflict (energy costs, helium/aluminum supply, shipping).

notes: SCOPE: Teledyne (CIK 1094285) Q1/24-Q4/25, Q1/26, Q2/26, FY2024, FY2025, 1H/26: is, seg, ops, adj_oi, adj_ni (no bs/cf). USD millions, shares millions. Fiscal periods: FY2024 = 1-Jan-2024 to 29-Dec-2024 (52 wks); FY2025 = 30-Dec-2024 to 28-Dec-2025 (52 wks); Q1/26 ended 29-Mar-2026, Q2/26 ended 28-Jun-2026. Source rule: each quarter taken from the LATEST earnings release presenting it (prior-year column of the following year's release; Q3/25, Q4/25, Q1/26, Q2/26 from their own releases since the Q3-26 release (due ~Oct-2026) was not yet filed). FY2024/FY2025 from the Q4-25 release (filed 21-Jan-2026) cross-checked to the FY2025 10-K; 1H/26 from the Q2-26 release six-month columns, identical to the Q2-26 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428526000043/tdy-20260628.htm).

IS PRESENTATION: Releases from Q1-25 onward (and the FY2024 10-K) split Research and development out of SG&A; 2024 quarters were recast in the 2025 releases (e.g. Q1/24 SG&A 296.2 as originally reported = 219.7 SG&A + 76.5 R&D; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428525000062/q1-2025earningsrelease.htm). Per spec, is.sga = SG&A + R&D (the company total), is.sga_ex_rd = SG&A line, is.rd_company = R&D line (company-funded R&D as presented on the IS). "Acquired intangible asset amortization" is a separate IS line inside operating income in every period: it is carried in is.other_op (negative, = -amortization, and in Q4/24 / FY2024 also -52.5 impairment) and repeated as memo is.amort_intangibles (positive). Identity: net_sales - cost_sales - sga + other_op = op_income (ties for all periods; also ties to "Total costs and expenses").

Q4/24 & FY2024 IMPAIRMENT: $52.5m pretax non-cash impairment of indefinite-lived trademarks (DI 49.5, Instrumentation 3.0). The releases include it in SG&A (Q4-24 release SG&A 355.9 incl. R&D; Q4-25 release Q4/24 SG&A 284.5 + R&D 71.4, footnote (a)); the FY2024 10-K presents it as a separate line "Impairment of acquired intangible assets" (SG&A 902.6). Here it is excluded from sga/sga_ex_rd and included in other_op (memo is.impairment_intangibles = 52.5) for Q4/24 and 2024. Excluded from non-GAAP as "Non-cash trademark impairments" (cat IMPAIR) - first and only use of this adjustment (Q4/24; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428525000003/q4-2024earningsrelease.htm).

OTHER INCOME / DEBT EXTINGUISHMENT: is.other_income is "Other income (expense), net" as presented in the releases and 10-Qs, which INCLUDES gains on debt extinguishment (bond repurchases below par): Q2/25 3.3, Q3/25 7.2, Q4/25 4.5 (= FY 15.0 - 9M 10.5), FY2025 15.0 (memo is.gain_debt_ext). The FY2025 10-K presents "Gain (loss) on debt extinguishment" 15.0 as a separate line and Other income (expense), net as -21.6; here FY2025 other_income = -6.6 (combined, as in the Q4-25 release) so quarters sum to FY. These gains are NOT adjusted out of non-GAAP EPS. Sources: Q2-25 10-Q MD&A, Q3-25 10-Q MD&A (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428525000140/tdy-20250928.htm), FY2025 10-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428526000017/tdy-20251228.htm).

NCI: small redeemable NCI until Q3-25 ("Acquisition of noncontrolling interest" -27.2 in Q3-25 cash flow); NCI line shows "—" (0) from Q4/25 onward. is.income_cont = net income incl. NCI (no discontinued operations in the period).

BASIC EPS/SHARES: from 10-Qs (prior-year columns where later) and 10-Ks; not disclosed for Q4/24 and Q4/25 (releases show diluted only), so omitted there. FY2024 basic 47.0m / $17.43; FY2025 46.8m / $19.12.

MEMO D&A/SBC/CAPEX: from release narrative/cash-flow tables (latest mention). Q4/24 D&A was 77.1 in the Q4-24 release and 77.2 in the Q4-25 release (used; ties to FY 309.9). is.depreciation is DERIVED = da - amort_intangibles (not disclosed directly). Quarterly D&A/SBC/capex/FCF sum exactly to FY2024 (309.9/37.7/83.7/1,108.2) and FY2025 (336.3/39.6/117.3/1,074.0). 1H/26 D&A 172.9, SBC 19.5, capex 60.2, CFO 549.2 from the Q2-26 10-Q; the company did not publish a 1H/26 FCF figure (CFO-capex would be 489.0), so ops.fcf_published is omitted for 1H/26. Pension expense not disclosed in releases (only non-service retirement benefit income on IS).

NON-GAAP DEFINITION (adj_oi / adj_ni), 2024-2026: Non-GAAP OI excludes acquired intangible asset amortization, transaction & integration costs (2024 Q1-Q3 labelled "FLIR integration costs"), inventory step-up expense (from Q1-25, Micropac/Qioptiq), and in Q4/24 non-cash trademark impairments. Non-GAAP NI/EPS additionally excludes "FLIR acquisition-related tax matters" (post-acquisition interest on FLIR income-tax reserves and benefits/costs on settlement/resolution of FLIR tax reserves; labelled "Acquisition-related tax matters" in the Q1-24 release) and remeasurement of deferred taxes on acquired intangibles from tax-law changes (none in this window). Label/definition changes: (i) Q4-24 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428525000003/q4-2024earningsrelease.htm) renamed "FLIR integration costs" to "Transaction and integration costs" (broader: legal/accounting/professional fees, integration, employee separation incl. change-in-control payments, facility consolidation/lease impairments) and added "Non-cash trademark impairments"; later releases recast the 2024 comparatives under the new label with unchanged amounts. (ii) Q1-25 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428525000062/q1-2025earningsrelease.htm) added "Inventory step-up expense". (iii) Severance and facility consolidation costs NOT within transaction & integration costs remain in non-GAAP results (disclosed Q3/25 7.3 total, DI 6.0; Q3/24 1.6, DI 1.4; ops.severance_facility_not_in_ti; FY severance & facility consolidation costs 18.6 in 2025, 15.6 in 2024 per 10-K). (iv) The non-cash debt-extinguishment gains (FY2025 15.0) are not excluded.

adj_ni STRUCTURE: the company bridge is a three-column table (pretax / NI attributable to Teledyne / diluted EPS) per item with no separate tax line. Each pre-tax item is recorded with value = pre-tax amount, value_net = company after-tax amount, value_eps; a derived TAX item = sum(after-tax) - sum(pre-tax) is added so that base_value + sum(value) = adj_ni_published exactly; TAXD items (FLIR acquisition-related tax matters) carry their NI amount in value (benefit negative, expense positive) plus value_eps. adj_ni also gives pretax_gaap and adj_pretax_published (non-GAAP pretax income). Company per-share items sum to published non-GAAP EPS in every period. Amortization tax effect implied ~23-24% (e.g. Q2/26 56.0 pretax -> 42.9 after tax).

TAXD detail: FLIR acquisition-related tax matters (NI effect): Q1/24 +0.3, Q2/24 +0.2, Q3/24 -61.7 (resolution of an uncertain tax position on a pre-acquisition FLIR tax matter; ETR -2.8%), Q4/24 -16.6, FY2024 -77.8; Q1/25 0, Q2/25 -7.7, Q3/25 +0.2, Q4/25 -20.8, FY2025 -28.3; Q1/26 +0.5, Q2/26 -0.5, 1H/26 0. Q1/24 discrete items: release text says "$0.3 million of acquisition related discrete income tax expense". Total net discrete tax benefits (incl. non-FLIR items such as share-based accounting) in ops.discrete_tax_benefit; FY2025 tax included 8.3 share-based benefit, FY2024 12.7.

RESTATEMENT (segment non-GAAP, Q3/24): the Q3-25 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428525000137/q3-2025earningsrelease.htm) shows Q3/24 amortization DI 46.1 / Instrumentation 3.5 and non-GAAP OI DI 173.7 / Inst 99.8 vs 46.0 / 3.6 and 173.6 / 99.9 in the original Q3-24 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428524000099/q3-2024earningsrelease.htm); consolidated totals unchanged (49.8 / 324.2). Later figures used, so FY2024 segment amortization (DI 183.3, Inst 13.9 per Q4-25 release and 10-K) differs from the sum of quarters by 0.1 each (183.4 / 13.8); adj_oi_di/adj_oi_inst FY vs sum of quarters likewise +/-0.1. No other restatements of 2024-2025 figures found (all IS/segment/recon lines compared across every release presenting them).

SEGMENT NOTES: seg.corp_exp positive = expense; seg.adj_corp is the non-GAAP corporate line as presented (negative, e.g. Q2/26 -27.8 = -28.0 + 0.2 T&I). seg_items lists segment-level non-GAAP items other than amortization (T&I, step-up, impairments) with seg codes di/inst/ade/es/corp. Segment GAAP OI + amortization + seg_items = adj_oi_<seg> for every segment/period; segment adj OI + adj_corp = consolidated non-GAAP OI. Engineered Systems has no acquired intangible amortization (amort_es = 0, shown "—"). Product lines: Instrumentation levels from the 10-Q/10-K revenue note (Marine Instrumentation = inst_marine, Environmental Instrumentation = inst_env, Test and Measurement Instrumentation = inst_etm); Q4/24 and Q4/25 = FY (10-K) - 9M (Q3 10-Q) (derived). The company states "All other segments each contain one product line", so A&DE (aerospace electronics / defense electronics) and Engineered Systems (engineered products / energy systems) levels are not disclosed; the releases give only YoY $ changes, recorded as ade_aero_chg, ade_def_chg, es_eng_chg, es_energy_chg (vs same quarter prior year). Annual seg (2024, 2025) adds 10-K segment D&A (da_*), capex (capex_*), identifiable assets (assets_*), inter-segment sales, and segment cost of sales / SG&A / R&D (cogs_*, sga_*, rd_*; segment SG&A excludes corporate expense which sits in SG&A).

ACQUISITIONS & INCREMENTAL SALES (ops.acq_sales, as stated; per-segment acq_sales_<seg> from segment narratives): Valeport (closed 10-Apr-2024, $35.0m, Instrumentation/marine), Adimec (4-Jun-2024, $88.7m, Digital Imaging), Micropac (30-Dec-2024 i.e. first day of FY2025, $51.2m, A&DE), Qioptiq = select aerospace & defense electronics businesses of Excelitas Technologies (OS business, N. Wales UK + US AES business; closed 3-Feb-2025 per 10-K (release said 31-Jan), $702.8m, A&DE), TransponderTech (carve-out from Saab, 31-Oct-2025, $57.2-57.9m, Digital Imaging), DD-Scientific (14-Jan-2026, Instrumentation/environmental gas sensors). Stated incremental sales: Q1/24 and Q2/24 none stated (FY2024 49.4 implies ~14.1 in Q2/24, derived, not recorded); Q3/24 18.0 = DI 10.8 + Inst 7.2 (segment statements only, no consolidated figure stated); Q4/24 17.3 (DI 12.2, Inst 5.1); FY2024 49.4. Q1/25 55.6 (DI 8.9, Inst marine 4.4, A&DE 42.3 "current and prior year acquisitions"); Q2/25 70.1 (DI 5.8, A&DE 64.3); Q3/25 69.0 (A&DE 69.0); Q4/25 73.0 (DI 4.5, A&DE 68.5); FY2025 270.1 (Q4-25 release and 10-K) vs quarterly sum 267.7 (2.4 gap, unexplained in filings). Q1/26 33.3 (DI 8.0, Inst env 5.0, A&DE 20.3 - Qioptiq January stub before 3-Feb anniversary); Q2/26 12.2 (DI 6.1 TransponderTech, Inst env 6.1 DD-Scientific); 1H/26 not stated (sum 45.5). Acquisition cash: FY2024 123.7, FY2025 821.4, 1H/26 53.4.

OPS: orders disclosed only for Q1/24 (1,433.2; Q4/23 1,519.4 for reference); later releases describe orders qualitatively only (orders > sales for consecutive quarters; "record" orders Q3/25, Q4/25, Q2/26). Funded backlog stated only in Q2/26 ("approximately $5.0 billion"). ops.rpo (extra key) = remaining performance obligations from 10-Q/10-K revenue notes (not the same as funded backlog): Dec-24 3,700.5; Mar-25 4,214.5; Jun-25 4,452.8; Sep-25 4,569.2; Dec-25 4,611.7; Mar-26 4,867.4; Jun-26 5,176.1. leverage_published = "consolidated leverage ratio" from release bullets. net_debt_published / total_debt_published from the release non-GAAP net debt table (current portion of LTD + LTD - cash). etr = effective tax rate stated; etr_ex_discrete where stated. Annual 10-K: sales_us_gov (US Government as prime or sub) and region-by-destination rev_us/rev_europe/rev_asia/rev_other, per-segment US Gov sales, employees (~14,900 at 29-Dec-2024; ~15,800 at 28-Dec-2025), international ~48% of sales both years.

CAPITAL DEPLOYMENT CONTEXT: buybacks FY2024 $353.9m (885.3k shares), Q4/25 $400.0m (~0.8m shares at $507.52), FY2025 $402.9m incl. excise tax; buyback authorization raised to $2.0bn in Jul-2025. Debt: $450m maturity repaid 1-Apr-2024 (Q2/24), $150.4m other debt repaid Q4/24, $315m revolver drawn Q1/25 for acquisitions and repaid Q2/25, bonds repurchased below par in 2025 (principal 177.0 for ~162.0 cash), $450m maturity repaid at start of Q2/26. Credit facility $1.20bn (amended Jun-2024, maturity Jun-2029).

CHECKS PERFORMED: (1) IS arithmetic ties for every period (sales->OI via other_op; OI->pretax; tax; NCI); (2) segment sales/OI sum to consolidated; (3) every adj_oi reconciliation ties (oi_gaap + items = adj_oi_published) and segment-level recon ties; (4) every adj_ni bridge ties (base + items = adj_ni_published; pretax column ties; per-share items sum to adj EPS); (5) Q1-Q4 sums = FY for all IS lines, segment sales/OI, consolidated adj items, memo D&A/SBC/capex/FCF (exceptions noted: Q3/24 segment amortization restatement, FY2025 acq_sales); Q1/26+Q2/26 = 1H/26 for all lines; (6) XBRL companyfacts (local cache) agree for revenue (RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax), cost of sales, R&D, amortization, OI, pretax, tax, NI, basic & diluted EPS, capex - 187 fact comparisons, zero differences.

OUTLOOK Q4-25 RELEASE (21-Jan-2026, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428526000008/q4-2025earningsrelease.htm) full text: "Based on its current outlook, the company's management believes that first quarter 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $4.45 to $4.59, and full year 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $19.76 to $20.22. The company's management further believes that first quarter 2026 non-GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $5.40 to $5.50, and full year 2026 non-GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $23.45 to $23.85. The non-GAAP outlook excludes acquired intangible asset amortization, transaction and integration costs, and inventory step-up expense." Bridge table: Q1/26 T&I 0.02/0.01, step-up 0.01/—, amortization 0.92/0.90; FY2026 T&I 0.02/0.01, step-up 0.01/—, amortization 3.66/3.62. No tax-rate/sales/capex guidance stated.

OUTLOOK Q1-26 RELEASE (22-Apr-2026, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428526000024/q1-2026earningsrelease.htm) full text: "Based on its current outlook, the company's management believes that second quarter 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $4.75 to $4.90, and full year 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $20.08 to $20.44. The non-GAAP outlook excludes certain transaction and integration costs and acquired intangible asset amortization." Bridge table: Q2/26 T&I —/—, amortization 0.95/0.90; FY2026 T&I 0.01/—, amortization 3.75/3.70, FLIR acquisition-related tax matters 0.01/0.01 (the Q1/26 +0.5m FLIR tax expense). OUTLOOK Q2-26 RELEASE (22-Jul-2026, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428526000039/q2-2026earningsrelease.htm) full text: "Based on its current outlook, the company's management believes that third quarter 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $5.10 to $5.25, and full year 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $20.73 to $20.99. The company's management further believes that third quarter 2026 non-GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $6.05 to $6.15, and full year 2026 non-GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $24.45 to $24.65. The non-GAAP outlook excludes certain transaction and integration costs and acquired intangible asset amortization." Bridge table: Q3/26 GAAP 5.10/5.25, T&I —/—, amortization 0.95/0.90, non-GAAP 6.05/6.15; FY2026 GAAP 20.73/20.99, T&I 0.02/0.01, amortization 3.70/3.65, non-GAAP 24.45/24.65 (FLIR tax line dropped since 1H/26 FLIR tax matters net to zero). Headline bullet: "Raising full year 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share outlook to $20.73 to $20.99 compared with the prior outlook of $20.08 to $20.44, and raising full year 2026 non-GAAP earnings per share outlook to $24.45 to $24.65, compared with the prior outlook of $23.85 to $24.15". Implied 2H/26 (derived): GAAP 10.53-10.79, non-GAAP 12.39-12.59 vs 1H/26 actual 10.20 / 12.06; implied Q4/26 (derived) GAAP 5.28-5.69, non-GAAP 6.24-6.54. Implied FY2026 after-tax amortization ~ $3.65-3.70 x ~46.9m diluted shares = ~$171-174m (~$224-227m pretax at the ~23.5% tax effect seen in 1H/26 amortization (113.6 pretax -> 86.9 after tax); derived, not company-stated). No tax-rate, sales-growth, capex, FCF, interest, pension or SBC guidance was given in any 2025-2026 release.
